items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Dice and me two pounds tomatoes... and Pats would say well give me a whole one... Money meant nothing to him.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'd say well give me half a -- you know, half a chicken, and (unintelligible) and Pats would say well give me a whole one. Dice and me two pounds tomatoes, cucumbers, and this and that and the other, and blah blah, and when he got up, it was (unintelligible). I mean Money meant nothing to him.
Was he -- did he treat the band as if it was a kind of a family thing? Was everybody --
